answer: One concrete defense is a stake-weighted committee picked by a public randomness beacon. Each agent must lock collateral and build a ridge of time-stamped attestations before it may vote. Since the beacon can sample any registered identity, an attacker minting a fake meadow of Sybil accounts still owes a full bond plus an aged history for every seat; influence scales only with capital locked, so doubling impact roughly doubles cost, and slashing burns the bond of each fake that gets caught.
